note: Avatar maker settings. Models are swappable here: set `version` for a community model, leave it null for an official one.

generate.prompt: The first two images are grid guides showing our camera: a true -33 degree downward angle, rotated 45 degrees, very long flat lens. Recreate the person from the remaining photos as a full-body figure standing on this floor, seen from exactly that camera. Keep their face, body, build, hair and outfit. Natural standing pose. Soft natural daylight, plain flat light gray background, no props, full body in frame with space around.

normalize.note: Brief 02c said band 0.04 / lift 0.03. Measured on the hand-placed presets the cross sits 4 to 9% above the lowest pixel (median 7.5%): the near foot's toe is always lowest at this camera, and a 4% band only sees that one shoe. Run `npx tsx scripts/normalize-avatar.ts --check-presets` after changing these.
